post.description:
Creates an account. Needs an invite code unless registration is open; with a code the
new user also joins that group (`joined_group`).
Ends the session that owns this refresh token. Always succeeds (idempotent).
Ends every session of the current user, including this one.
Changes the password, signs out all other sessions and returns new tokens for this one.

Deletes the account: owned groups go to the oldest admin (or member), or are deleted if
you are alone in them; you leave every group; your profile is anonymized.
Creates a group owned by the caller.
The target becomes owner; the caller becomes admin.

get.description: Owner, then admins, then members; each by name.

delete.description:
Removes a member, or leaves the group when ``user_id`` is the caller.

The only member leaving deletes the group.

get.description: Newest first (at most 100). Admins see every invite, members only their own.
Public: shows which group an invite is for and whether it can still be used.

post.description: Joins the group as a member. Accepting again when already a member changes nothing.

get.description:
Top-level categories by position, then name; each with its subcategories in the same
order.

post.description: Any member. ``position: null`` appends at the end among the siblings.

put.description:
The creator or an admin. ``position: null`` keeps the current position; a field's type
can't change (remove it and add it back).

delete.description:
The creator or an admin. A subcategory's activities move to its parent; deleting a
top-level category deletes its subcategories and leaves their activities uncategorized.

get.description:
The backlog, cursor-paginated. Due date and cost sort with nulls last; ties are broken
by id (descending).

Replaces the content; send the ``version`` you last read. ``owner_id: null`` means
unowned. A member may claim an unowned activity, the owner may hand it to anyone or to
nobody, and admins may do anything.

EventRef.title: EventRef
EventRef.description: A calendar event linked to an activity (``Activity.events``, by ``window_start``).

FieldDef.title: FieldDef
FieldDef.description:
A custom field of a category (contract section 6.1). The list order is the display order.

Shape rules are checked here, so errors point at e.g. ``field_defs.2.options``. Rules that
need other categories (key conflicts, type changes) are checked by the service.

OccurrenceRef.title: OccurrenceRef
OccurrenceRef.description: The next occurrence of an activity's linked events (``ActivitySummary.next_occurrence``).
